name: minecraft-damage-type

schema.description: A damage type's for a Minecraft data pack config schema
schema.title: Minecraft Data Pack Damage Type

description:
The new damage type has been registered under the identifier **minecraft:player.smite**. Its scaling behavior is set to **when_caused_by_living_non_player**, meaning the damage will scale only when it originates from a non‑player living entity. The exhaustion cost applied to the affected player is **0.1**, and the damage will also apply the **burning** effect.

All standard death messages will be used for this damage type, as the **death_message_type** is configured to **default**. This ensures that players killed by the smite damage will see the usual vanilla death text without any custom variation.
